headline: CIN @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 3.86 at STL 4.52, with a projected total of 8.38. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward STL: CIN moved +0.30 runs while STL moved +1.11, changing the projected margin by -0.81 runs. The projected total climbed +1.41, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -15.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Matthew Liberatore has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for JJ Bleday, Nelson Velázquez, Spencer Steer, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nolan Gorman, Matt McLain because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
